name: deploying-to-cloud
title_zh: Laravel Cloud 上从建库到定时任务的命令
tagline_zh: 部署 Laravel 不用再开浏览器点十几个页面：建应用、配库、挂队列、绑域名、看账单，全在终端里一条条敲完。
tagline_en: Stop clicking through the Laravel Cloud dashboard. Create apps, databases, queues, domains and check spend.
desc_en: Deploys and manages Laravel applications on Laravel Cloud using the `cloud` CLI. Use when the user wants to deploy an app, ship to cloud, create/manage applications, environments, databases, caches, object storage, queues, domains, instances, background processes, secrets, compute, scheduled tasks, check billing/usage/spend, or any Laravel Cloud infrastructure. Triggers on deploy, ship, cloud mana
why_zh: 把 Laravel Cloud 的控制台操作映射成 cloud CLI 命令，环境、缓存、对象存储。
why_en: Maps the whole Laravel Cloud console onto cloud CLI commands, so environments, caches, storage, workers and schedules share one.
limit_zh: 只对 Laravel Cloud 生效，自建服务器、Forge、Vapor、其他云一律不管。
limit_en: Laravel Cloud only — no Forge, Vapor, self-hosted or other clouds. Requires the cloud CLI installed and authenticated; without an account or billing.
title_en: Manage Laravel Cloud apps from the CLI
